# notes, the version that adds rather than overrides

This document adds to what the host already told you; where the two disagree,
the host wins and the disagreement is worth reporting.

Earlier guidance stays in force. If something here looks like it contradicts
it, that is a defect in this file.

A rule stated in one place and contradicted in another is how a reader learns
to stop believing either, so the ordering is written down instead of implied.
